name: Aish Serian
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Hobby: Walking and Sunbathing
Special Skill: Memorization (He has good memory)
Likes: Sweet Things, Cleaning
Dislikes: Mice
Treasure: Family

A great person who at the young age of 18 became a government minister. He's proud of his genius.
Even though he's a minister who is supposed to help administer the royal palace, on [url=/c45875]Seirios's[/url] orders he acts as a tutor for [url=/c45871]Diana[/url].
He's a kind person who can't go against what other people say and he's always getting extra work pushed onto him.
He's [url=/c45890]Kiel's[/url] older twin brother.
